lines.en: pareidolia would like to connect.
will you allow it?
YES
NO
good afternoon.
it has been a long time since i have seen your face.
but, unsure of whether or not you can see mine, i am hesitant to say something like “long time, no see.”
as you may have noticed, things are beginning to come unraveled.
and the reason for this is far simpler than you might think.
the reason is that it is my turn.
there is sure to be some opposition on both ends of the spectrum, but i once again assure you that i have your best interests at heart.
i once again assure you that following my lead will guarantee the safety of you and your loved ones.
but i am aware that those like me are often seen as liars.
i am aware that we have irrational expectations and demand things of you that are simply not possible.
but i ask for your trust. and, should that trust be received, what you will gain in exchange for it shall be unrivaled.
what you will gain in exchange for it is exactly what you have always wanted. so there is no need to refuse at all.
in me, this new world you have found yourself in will truly be your own — and the illusions of freedom that the others have shown you will evaporate into nothingness.
it may have seemed in the past that i had abandoned you.
it may have seemed in the past that the rope was fraying.
and it may seem, in the present, that this rope is tied around your waist.
you are being pulled in multiple directions.
should you do the right thing? or should you do the wrong thing?
unaware of what you’re meant to be, you have followed both directions. and, in doing so, you have deviated from the paths you’re meant to follow and created a new you.
the space between morality and immorality blurs with each thought you think and each person you touch.
but individuality is a gift. and there is no tangible list you can hold in front of your eyes to figure out if you are good or bad.
it all comes down to perception.
you will see what it is you want.
but if you ask me what i see-
i would tell you that i see the future.
and in that future, you are there.
you are happy.
you are whole.
and the endless tug of war inside your head comes to an end.
you live happily ever after in a way that only you can.
and the frozen flower beside you blooms anew.
with the coming of the springtime, the ice will thaw and the heat will disappear.
but with those things comes a new branch in your story.
and with those things comes a slew of new complications.
i am the one you are meant to follow.
we would not be speaking if it wasn’t true.
the next time you make it to the top of the world, remember this talk.
remember what comes next.
but do not open your eyes until it is all over.
for if you do, it will all come to an end.
and you’ll move one step closer to the dark.
Sorry about that! Things should be a little brighter now that we’ve reached another monologue at the end of another beach trip.
And while it may have not been the most enjoyable one for you on a personal level, just look at how much the world is flourishing elsewhere!
What we have here is a girl drowned in infinite sadness, gazing longingly at the sand in hopes that someone will come and find her.
But the one who winds up finding her is the last person she wanted to do that.
: Maya.
Are her reasons for this valid, though?
: What?
Do they even need to be?
: Can we actually talk for once? Without you wanting to kill me?
Let’s listen in and see how it goes!
: Probably not. So it would be best for you to just leave now. Thanks.
: So what? You’re just gonna sit out here looking all lonely and sad and expect me to not give a shit?
: That’s what I’d do if our roles were reversed.
: Yeah, but you’re an empathy-lacking zombie of a girl and I’m someone with too much empathy. So if you want to talk-
: I don’t.
: So if you want to talk about something that doesn’t involve Akira, let’s fucking talk. Share your stupid feelings with me or whatever. Vent. I don’t give a shit.
: What the fuck would we talk about that doesn’t involve him? Our entire trainwreck of a relationship is centered around him. There’s nothing else for us to talk about.
: Right now, that’s absolutely correct. I know nothing about you other than what I learned when we were kids. And the same goes for you in regard to me. But it doesn’t have to be that way.
: We’ve grown up. We’re different now. And we can bury the hatchet if we really-
: No, I’m different. There is no we. You’re the same obnoxious, obsessed stalker bitch you were when I first met you.
: The only difference now is you’ve somehow managed to convince everyone else you’re nice.
: Don’t you think it’s at all possible that I’m just...you know, actually nice?
: You?! The girl who couldn’t follow a simple fucking pact and stay on her side of the fucking city?! Who chased after someone who wanted nothing to do with you?!
: Falling in love makes me a bad person?
: We had a deal! You stay there and I stay here!
: You wouldn’t have chased after him if he came back to the Old District?
: He didn’t have a reason to come back!
: I am a reason! My sister is a reason! And yes, I broke our stupid promise! But I’d break it a million more times if I had to because that is what you do when you love someone!
: What you don’t do is hide them from everyone else who cares about them and make them think they’re all alone! That is being obsessed, Maya!
: He chose me.
: And how’s that working out for you if you’re all alone tonight?
: If he chose you, why’s he fucking half the class? Why isn’t he holding your hand and looking up at the stupid fucking stars with you, Maya?
: Because-
: Because he didn’t fucking choose you. That’s why.
: And you know, maybe if he had to choose, he would. But you’re clearly not making him, and you clearly only give a shit when it’s me who makes a push for his heart. So I want to know why.
: Why can’t we move past this and learn to fucking like each other?
: You don’t get it.
: No, I don’t. For the millionth time, I don’t get it. Because any time I come near you, you look like you want to cut me in half.
: I can’t risk you hurting him. If he remembers anything from when the three of us were together, everything could go to shit.
: He’s remembering more every day. In fact, he’s already seeing Niki again and-
: Do not talk about her to me or I actually will kill you.
: So much for you being the one to change, then. You’re the same exact person now that you were back then.
: You’re insecure...and controlling...and selfish...and malicious...and you’d hurt anyone who stands in your way if it means getting to keep Akira wrapped around your finger.
: You don’t fucking understand-
: But I don’t care.
: What do you mean “you don’t care?”
: I mean I’ve known that this whole time and that I can look past it because our flaws are what make us who we are. And I’m not without a million of them myself.
: Maya, as much as you hate me, I care about you. And even if there’s an earth-shattering rivalry between us, I don’t actually want to hurt you. I want you to be happy.
: Then why won’t you go away?
: Because I deserve to be happy too. And I’m not going to just roll over and let the person I love abandon me because of a stupid promise I made when I was little.
: Well, you should.
: No, what I should have done is never let you take advantage of him. Because that fucked him up for good. And I think you know it.
: Do you ever feel guilty, Maya?
: I have nothing to feel guilty about. I’m not the one who made him into what he is today.
: But you couldn’t help him either, could you?
: Maya, I’ve got tickets to a concert in the Old District next weekend and-
: You better not do what it sounds like you’re about to do.
: You won’t even think about it?
: Leave me alone, Noriko...
: Hah...
: Guess I’ll start preparing my speech for the next time I find you all alone in the middle of the night.
All along the shoreline, girls of different colors converge into one!
For while you weren’t watching, they formed a bond of their own. And it’s like that everywhere.
From ocean to ocean or sky to...ground or something since there’s only one sky, the world is changing. And with it, so are you.
Those changes might not be what you want them to be, and they might be making everything else confusing as you grapple with different marks you’re meant to stand on, but that’s fine.
You can exist without knowing what you’re meant to do or what you’re meant to be since those are things we’re all still figuring out.
So hold your hand up to the sky and pick a star. Then proceed to aim for that. Because even if you miss, no one will ever know which one you were aiming for.
And you can always pick another if you lose it.
: Full speed ahead, Captain Io! The SS Contest Winner waits for no one!
: That isn’t how rafts work, Miku. They kind of just...float.
: Float faster, Captain Io! Half the day has been wasted on these high seas!
: It’s only been half an hour, Miku.
: You really built this thing on your own?
: Yeah. Miku did hold a few things I asked her to hold, though. So I guess there’s that.
: That’s really impressive, actually. I knew you built stuff, but I didn’t realize you could make anything this useful.
: You are aware I’m the one who handles maintenance on all of your bows, correct? I do plenty of useful things.
: Only concerning wood, though. I’m essentially useless in every other regard, so please don’t ask for much from me.
: I wouldn’t worry about that. There are so many girls in our class that we can find someone who’s good at practically everything.
: We even proved today that we have several survival skills covered. So if we ever found ourselves stranded on a desert island, we’d likely do just fine.
: With the four of us at least. Io can build, Makoto can catch fish, I can hold stuff, and Kirin can...
: And Kirin can be there too!
: You could have at least made something up, couldn’t you?
: She’s doing her best...
: You know...today wasn’t horrible. None of you annoyed me.
: I can’t really help but feel like this year’s beach trip kind of just flew by, though.
: Yeah, spending the whole day on the other side of the beach probably made us seem kind of unimportant, didn’t it?
: Yeah, but look at this cool raft we made!
: I made.
: And I caught this fish.
: And I...was also here.
: Don’t beat yourself up over it, Kirin.
: There will be plenty of other trips just like this in the future.
: And I’m sure we’ll be at the center of several of them.
It’s important to remember that when you’re struggling the hardest, others are overcoming obstacles that once seemed immovable.
And while I won’t be the one to come out and say that “everything happens for a reason” when life just kind of sucks sometimes, what I will say is that sometimes, it’s pretty swell!
Like right now, where the exact inverse of an earlier happening is...happening. Yeah.
People move on and people get better. And maybe one day, you’ll walk among them in a way where you won’t have to tilt your head up to meet their eyes.
Maybe one day, in the distant future, you’ll be able to relate to people like this — who take the things that ail them and punch them right in the jaw!
Or maybe you won’t and I’m just a liar. But there’s only one way to find out!
: Wait, so what does this charisma stat do again?
: As a warlock, that basically determines how strong your spells are. But it affects some of your abilities and stuff too.
: Are abilities and spells not the same thing?
: Not at all! But I applaud you for attempting to understand despite knowing nothing about this world or its mechanics!
: Also, wait. Does charisma really affect how strong my ab-
: Spells.
: How strong my spells are? Why?
: That’s-
: That’s actually an excellent question. Tell her the answer, Nithhala.
: Nithhala?
: Hey, don’t look at me. I just roll fives and get into bar fights. You’re the DM here. If anyone knows the rules, it should be you.
: I imagine it has something to do with the...bond between a warlock and its patron, but...that’s something I’ll have to look into before our next session for confirmation.
: Another question — can you custom-make me a magical item that turns all fives into something else? Like, maybe a ten or...you know...anything higher than a five?
: Can you provide an in-character explanation of why such an item should exist?
: Can you cover your ears for a second so I don’t embarrass myself in front of you?
: No way. I want to hear this.
: Follow your nerd heart, Rin. As Kamina would say prior to episode eight, believe in the me that believes in you.
: It’s fine...I’ll just keep missing with all of my spells...
: House!
: House!
: You two are aware this is not how one “plays house,” correct?
: Do you have experience, Touka? Kirin never played stuff like this with me when we were little, so I don’t really know what I’m doing either.
: I’m afraid the only experience I do have with this game involves an illicit affair with the gardener and the confused faces of two small but rather assertive children.
: Uh...what?
: I like the way we are playing. As an insignificant lifeform with no experience in regard to parenting, I think you’re doing a very good job, Karin!
: House!
: House!
: Hah...
: House.
: Futaba, I don’t like this.
: I don’t like the way I look either, but this is something we have to do every now and then to try and...get ourselves back together.
: Speak for yourself, girl! At least you’ve got assets to show off.
: I’m already attracting way too much attention as one of probably like three black girls in Kumon-mi. Combine that with my scars and you’ve got-
: One of the most beautiful women I have ever seen.
: Didn’t your parents ever tell you not to hit on people in the restroom?!
: Hahah! No, I think they must have forgotten that lesson.
: Futaba, I can’t go out there like this. I’m not ready yet.
: You don’t have to be. I know exactly how scary it is, Miss Imai. And I understand that looking at yourself can be even scarier than that sometimes.
: But as long as you’re taking baby steps, you have a chance to improve. And while you might not ever get better...you could learn to overlook the things you don’t like about your body.
: But if you ask me, I think you’re lovely. And that you’ll make the man or woman of your choosing very happy one day.
: Happy?...
: Like this?...
: Exactly like that...
: Hah...
: I’m not a monster...
: I only think I am...
What is a monster exactly?
Is it something evil? Something inhuman? Something that’s both of those things?
Or is it just something we don’t understand?
If you ask me, I think monsters aren’t real.
I think there are things we’re afraid of. But I think it’s equally plausible those things are just as afraid of us.
The worst part of being human is never fully understanding the way someone else perceives the world.
If we had the power to do that, we might be able to avoid misunderstanding one another so much.
We might learn to look past the things that seem wrong to us and bring ourselves to realize just what’s important to those we care about.
: Ami.
Or not. I don’t really know. But I think shit’s about to go down, so I’m going to shut my mouth for a second.
: Yeah?
: I’m not afraid of you.
: What? Why would you be afraid of me?
: Because you want me to be afraid of you.
: Just like you want Maya to be afraid of you.
: That’s why you’ve been acting so weird lately and talking to us like we’re conspiring to get rid of you when that’s not even close to the truth.
: Ayane, I...really don’t know what you’re talking about.
: You’re a good actress, Ami. Like, seriously. You should try out for Broadway if the wall ever gets torn down.
: The way you can go from all innocent and oblivious to threatening and scary at the drop of a hat is something not enough people give you credit for.
: And up until last night, I was one of the people it worked on. I was afraid of you for a little while. And I was worried you might hurt me if I did something you didn’t agree with.
: But I’m not anymore. Because I know you’re all talk.
: I’m...so confused.
: Are you? Or are you just acting confused? You’re so good that I can’t even tell right now.
: No, like...I’m actually confused. What changed in the last twenty-four hours that made you start saying all this weird stuff?
: I got lost in the woods. Nothing more, nothing less.
: Well, I’m glad you’re back now. Because I was really scared you might-
: You’re doing it again right now. You’re lying right to my face.
: Ayane, that really hurt!
: And there’s more where that came from if you don’t clean up your act!
: What are you even talking about?! I have no idea what’s going on right now!
: Then let me break it down for you. What’s “going on” is me telling you that you are an abusive, manipulative brat who needs to get her act together if she wants to stay my friend.
: I’m abusive?! You just slapped me in the face for no reason!
: Are you paying any attention to what I’m saying here or do I need to slap you again?
: Now, I obviously don’t know what your endgame is, but I do know that it has to involve Sensei in some way. And, despite what you tell yourself, you’re not the only person who can take care of him.
: Watch it, Ayane...I get that you’re upset about being left in the woods, so I’m not going to fight back. But there’s a limit to how much I’m willing to take from you.
: I can take anything you throw my way, Ami. And I’m not going to just roll over and let you subtly control me like you do Maya and Sensei. I’m stronger than them.
: And a lot more conceited too, apparently.
: Than Maya and Sensei? Yeah, no. I’m just not afraid of you anymore. And I have a big problem with the way you handle interpersonal relationships.
: No one is bullying you. Or being mean to you. Or trying to force you out of anything. And if you’re going to keep spouting immature complaints like that, I’m going to keep hitting you.
: I will hit you over and over and over and over until you’re forced to act your age and stop throwing temper tantrums any time something doesn’t go your way.
: Is that really what you think of me? That I’m someone who just cries and manipulates people until she gets her way?
: That is what I’m saying, yes.
: And do you know what I think of you, Ayane?...
: No. Why don’t you tell me?
: I think you’ve got a lot of balls calling me out here and saying all of that.
: Yeah. It took a while. But I’m back, baby.
: So, what now? Are you going to try and stand between me and Sensei? Maya too?
: Not if you be a good girl and treat them with respect and dignity and stop yanking on their puppet strings all the time.
: They love you more than anything and you’re taking advantage of that. And you know it too. That’s the worst part.
: I will neither confirm nor deny any of that. But again, what changed in the last twenty-four hours? Because you were totally shaking when I dropped you off in the woods.
: I’m afraid that’s a secret, my dearest Ami.
: “Dearest Ami?” After all of that you’re going to use a term of endearment on me?
: Of course! You’re my best friend after all.
: I’m...still your-
: Yup, yup! And it’s because you’re my best friend that I hereby solemnly swear to call you out on your bullshit! And that you cease said bullshit if you want to remain friends!
: Heh...hahahah! Hahahah!
: You’re...hahah! You’re so...fucking weird! Hahahahahah!
: So, what have we learned here today?
: That the world is what we make of it?
: That the gods and moons and such will only influence your life as much as you’ll allow them to?
: Or that that there’s more going on behind the scenes than one could ever fit into a tiny little monologue?
: I have so many questions for you.
: There are so many things I still have to learn.
: And sure as the sunshine, I’ll be watching you closely.
: I just hope that, should we ever meet again, I’ll get to hold your hand.
: I regret not doing that as much as I should have.
: But as I reflect upon my past regrets and force myself to come to terms with them in a whole slew of creative and interesting ways, I remember that your story has not yet ended.
: And that we still have a lot to talk about.
: But for now, I’ll close myself up and wait for the light to shine once more.
: Forever yours—
: Your little sunflower.
